description: Responsive optimization, animation polish, and final build verification. Add/fix mobile breakpoints for all modified components (320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px). Add scroll-triggered reveal animations using IntersectionObserver with CSS transitions (NO GSAP unless already imported). Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Final comprehensive build verification.
steps: INSPECT all components modified in FEAT-001, FEAT-002, FEAT-003: services, philosophy, approach, method, testimonials, membership, about, contact, footer. Open each .css file and check existing @media queries. List which breakpoints exist and which are missing.

RESPONSIVE: For each modified component, add/enhance @media queries. Standard breakpoints: @media (max-width: 480px) for mobile, @media (max-width: 768px) for tablet, @media (min-width: 1024px) for desktop, @media (min-width: 1440px) for large screens. Ensure: grid layouts stack properly (grid-template-columns: 1fr on mobile), font sizes scale down (clamp() or smaller rems), padding/margins reduce on mobile, buttons remain tappable (min 44px height), images don't overflow.

Services stats-row: On mobile, change from 4-column to 2-column grid, then 1-column below 480px. Why SKF 4-card grid: stack to 2-columns on tablet, 1-column on mobile. Testimonial card: reduce padding, smaller quote font on mobile (already mostly responsive but verify). Membership ec-grid: already responsive (3-col to 2-col to 1-col) but verify card padding reduces on mobile. Contact contact-main-grid: stack form and map vertically on mobile (form above, map below). Footer footer-grid: stack 4 columns to 2-on-tablet, 1-on-mobile.

ANIMATION POLISH: Check if GSAP is imported in any of the modified components. If NOT imported, DO NOT add it. Use CSS transitions + IntersectionObserver ONLY. For sections modified in FEAT-001/002/003, ensure they have .reveal class on main containers (check HTML). If missing, add .reveal class to section containers for scroll-triggered fade-in (already handled by app.ts initScrollReveal method).

Add CSS transitions for subtle interactions: stat counters (transition: transform 0.3s ease on hover for slight scale), Why SKF cards (box-shadow transition on hover), testimonial navigation arrows (transform translateY on hover), membership cards (existing hover effects verified), contact form inputs (focus transitions already added), footer links (color transition on hover). All transitions max 300ms. Add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { * { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; } } at top of styles.css.

STAGGER CARD ENTRY: For Why SKF 4-card grid and services stats, add staggered reveal. In the component CSS, add .reveal classes with nth-child delays: .card.reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; } .card.reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.1s; } etc. This works with existing IntersectionObserver in app.ts.

BUILD VERIFICATION PHASE 1: Run ng build --configuration development. Check terminal output for TypeScript errors, template errors, or missing dependencies. If errors exist, fix them before proceeding. Document any warnings in findings.

BUILD VERIFICATION PHASE 2: Run ng serve and open localhost:4200. Open browser DevTools console. Scroll through entire page and verify: no console errors, no 404s for images/assets, services stats animate when scrolled into view, Why SKF cards appear with stagger, testimonials auto-advance every 5 seconds, membership section readable on dark background, contact form submits (test with dummy data), footer links work.

RESPONSIVE TESTING: In browser DevTools, test responsive at 375px (mobile), 768px (tablet), 1024px (desktop), 1440px (large). Verify: all text readable, no horizontal overflow, images fit containers, grids stack properly, buttons remain tappable, no elements overlap. Test both portrait and landscape orientations on mobile sizes.

PRODUCTION BUILD: Run ng build (production mode). Verify build succeeds, check bundle sizes in terminal output (initial bundle should be <2MB per angular.json budgets). If bundle warning/error, identify cause in findings. Document final bundle sizes.

FINAL VERIFICATION CHECKLIST: Confirm all acceptance criteria from FEAT-001, FEAT-002, FEAT-003. Write summary in findings: what was changed, what was preserved, any warnings encountered, bundle sizes, performance notes. Set status to completed.
